user_stories.title: View entitled CIF and its accounts in a single-CIF summary
user_stories.description: As a Corporate User, I want to see the CIF I am entitled to view together with the relevant virtual accounts under it, so that I get an immediate overview of my company's virtual account position when I open the module.
user_stories.dependencies: Relies on the Corporate Banking System for CIF, virtual account data and the configured entitlements.
user_stories.business_validation_rules: The user must be onboarded, hold the virtual account inquiry entitlement and have a current account with a linked virtual account. Only the CIF and accounts the user is entitled to are displayed.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN an authenticated Corporate User entitled to a single CIF WHEN the user opens the Virtual Account module THEN the system displays the aggregated summary for that CIF with the virtual accounts the user is entitled to view
GIVEN the aggregated summary is displayed WHEN the user reviews the entity information THEN the system shows the CIF number and corporate name of the entitled entity
GIVEN the user is entitled to only some virtual accounts under the CIF WHEN the summary loads THEN the system shows only those entitled accounts and excludes all others
GIVEN a Corporate User without the virtual account inquiry entitlement WHEN the user attempts to open the module THEN the system denies access and displays a no-access message
GIVEN the Corporate Banking System is unavailable WHEN the user opens the module THEN the system displays a service-unavailable message instead of an empty or zero summary
additional_scenarios: GIVEN an entitled Corporate User whose current account has no linked virtual account WHEN the user opens the module THEN the system displays a message that no virtual accounts are linked
GIVEN the same Corporate User signs in on Web and on Mobile WHEN the summary is displayed on each channel THEN both channels show the same entitled CIF and accounts
GIVEN the user opens the aggregated summary WHEN the page is served THEN the access is recorded in the audit trail with user identity and timestamp
ears_requirements: When an entitled Corporate User with a single CIF opens the Virtual Account module, the system shall display the aggregated summary for that CIF with the user's entitled virtual accounts.
The system shall display the CIF number and corporate name of the entitled entity in the aggregated summary.
The system shall exclude from the aggregated summary every virtual account the user is not entitled to view.
If a user without the virtual account inquiry entitlement opens the module, then the system shall deny access and display a no-access message.
If the Corporate Banking System is unavailable, then the system shall display a service-unavailable message and shall not present an empty or zero summary.

user_stories.title: View virtual accounts across all entitled entities (multi-CIF)
user_stories.description: As a Corporate User, I want to view virtual account lists across all the entities I am entitled to, so that I can monitor group-wide collections from one place when my company operates under several CIFs.
user_stories.dependencies: Builds on the single-CIF summary in US-001. Relies on the Corporate Banking System for the CIF group and entitlements.
user_stories.business_validation_rules: All CIFs shown must be CIFs the user is entitled to; virtual accounts are included only where the user holds the entitlement.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN an authenticated Corporate User entitled to several CIFs WHEN the user opens the aggregated summary THEN the system offers an option to view virtual accounts across all entitled entities
GIVEN the user selects the all-entities option WHEN the summary refreshes THEN the system shows the virtual accounts of every entitled CIF in one consolidated view
GIVEN the consolidated view is displayed WHEN the user reviews an account THEN the system identifies the CIF to which each virtual account belongs
GIVEN the corporate group has a CIF the user is not entitled to WHEN the all-entities view loads THEN the system excludes that CIF and its virtual accounts
GIVEN data for one entitled CIF cannot be retrieved WHEN the all-entities view loads THEN the system shows the available CIFs and states that data for the affected CIF is not available
additional_scenarios: GIVEN a user entitled to only one CIF WHEN the summary loads THEN the system does not show the multi-CIF option and behaves as in the single-CIF scenario
GIVEN two entitled CIFs share the same current account name WHEN the consolidated view is displayed THEN the CIF number distinguishes their accounts
GIVEN the user switches to the all-entities view WHEN the view is displayed THEN the access is recorded in the audit trail
ears_requirements: When a Corporate User entitled to more than one CIF opens the aggregated summary, the system shall offer an option to view virtual accounts across all entitled entities.
When the all-entities option is selected, the system shall display the virtual accounts of every entitled CIF in one consolidated view.
The system shall identify the CIF of each virtual account in the consolidated view.
The system shall exclude from the consolidated view every CIF and virtual account the user is not entitled to.
If data for an entitled CIF cannot be retrieved, then the system shall display the remaining CIFs and indicate that data for the affected CIF is not available.

depends_on.reason: the single-CIF summary and entitlement scoping must exist before it is extended across CIFs

user_stories.title: Select specific entities to scope the summary
user_stories.description: As a Corporate User, I want to select specific entities from a list of my entitled CIFs, so that I can focus the summary on the subsidiaries or business units I am responsible for.
user_stories.dependencies: Builds on the multi-CIF view in US-002.
user_stories.business_validation_rules: The selection list contains only CIFs the user is entitled to; at least one entity must be selected.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN a Corporate User entitled to several CIFs WHEN the user opens entity selection THEN the system lists only the CIFs the user is entitled to
GIVEN the entity list is open WHEN the user selects one or more entities and confirms THEN the summary, counts and hierarchy show only the selected entities
GIVEN entities are selected WHEN the user navigates to the account list THEN the account list is scoped to the same selected entities
GIVEN the entity list is open WHEN the user deselects all entities THEN the system prevents confirmation and asks the user to select at least one entity
GIVEN the entity list cannot be loaded WHEN the user opens entity selection THEN the system displays a service-unavailable message and keeps the current selection
additional_scenarios: GIVEN the user previously selected specific entities WHEN the user chooses the all-entities option THEN the selection is cleared and all entitled entities are shown
GIVEN an entity's entitlement is removed during the session WHEN the summary is refreshed THEN that entity is removed from the selection and its accounts are no longer shown
GIVEN a long list of entitled CIFs WHEN the user types part of a CIF number or name in the selector THEN the list narrows to matching entitled CIFs
ears_requirements: When a multi-CIF Corporate User opens entity selection, the system shall list only the CIFs the user is entitled to.
When the user confirms a selection of entities, the system shall scope the summary, counts and hierarchy to the selected entities.
While an entity selection is active, the system shall apply the same selection to the virtual account list.
If the user attempts to confirm an empty entity selection, then the system shall prevent confirmation and request at least one entity.
If the entity list cannot be loaded, then the system shall display a service-unavailable message and retain the current selection.

depends_on.reason: entity selection narrows the multi-CIF consolidated view

user_stories.title: View the virtual account hierarchy per entitlement
user_stories.description: As a Corporate User, I want to see the hierarchy from Current Account to Root VA, Parent VA and Virtual Account as per my entitlement, so that I understand how my collection identifiers are structured under each physical account.
user_stories.dependencies: Relies on the Corporate Banking System for the VA hierarchy and the hierarchy-level entitlements.
user_stories.business_validation_rules: Permissions are managed by Current Account, Root VA, Parent VA or VA number; the hierarchy shows only nodes the user is entitled to.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN an entitled Corporate User on the aggregated summary WHEN the user opens the hierarchy view THEN the system shows the levels Current Account, Root VA, Parent VA and Virtual Account
GIVEN the hierarchy view is displayed WHEN the user expands a Current Account node THEN the system shows its Root VAs, then their Parent VAs, then the Virtual Accounts beneath them
GIVEN the user is entitled at Parent VA level only WHEN the hierarchy loads THEN the system shows that Parent VA and its entitled Virtual Accounts and does not expose sibling branches
GIVEN a user entitled to individual VAs only WHEN the hierarchy loads THEN the system shows only the paths leading to those VAs without revealing other VAs under the same parents
GIVEN the hierarchy cannot be retrieved WHEN the user opens the hierarchy view THEN the system displays a data-not-available message
additional_scenarios: GIVEN a Closed virtual account within the 12-month visibility window WHEN the hierarchy is displayed THEN the account appears with its Closed status
GIVEN a hierarchy with many virtual accounts WHEN the user expands a node THEN child nodes load without requiring the full hierarchy to be loaded at once
GIVEN the user selects a Virtual Account node WHEN the user clicks it THEN the system opens that account's details
ears_requirements: The system shall display the virtual account hierarchy at the levels Current Account, Root VA, Parent VA and Virtual Account.
When the user expands a hierarchy node, the system shall display the entitled child nodes of the next level.
The system shall display only the hierarchy nodes and paths permitted by the user's Current Account, Root VA, Parent VA or VA entitlement.
The system shall not reveal virtual accounts outside the user's entitlement through the hierarchy view.
If the hierarchy cannot be retrieved, then the system shall display a data-not-available message.

depends_on.reason: the hierarchy is part of the aggregated summary

user_stories.title: See VA counts per Parent VA, per Current Account and in total
user_stories.description: As a Corporate User, I want to see the number of virtual accounts linked to each Parent VA, to each Current Account and in total, so that I can gauge the size of my collection structure at a glance.
user_stories.dependencies: Uses the entitled hierarchy from US-004.
user_stories.business_validation_rules: Counts include only entitled virtual accounts and respect the current entity selection.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN an entitled Corporate User on the aggregated summary WHEN the summary loads THEN the system shows the total number of virtual accounts the user is entitled to
GIVEN the summary is displayed WHEN the user views a Current Account THEN the system shows the number of virtual accounts linked to that Current Account
GIVEN the summary is displayed WHEN the user views a Parent VA THEN the system shows the number of virtual accounts linked to that Parent VA
GIVEN the user is entitled to only part of a Parent VA's accounts WHEN the counts are shown THEN the counts reflect only the entitled accounts
GIVEN the account data cannot be retrieved WHEN the summary loads THEN the system displays the counts as not available instead of zero
additional_scenarios: GIVEN the user has selected specific entities WHEN the counts are displayed THEN the counts cover only the selected entities
GIVEN Closed accounts within the 12-month window exist WHEN the counts are displayed THEN the system indicates whether Closed accounts are included in the count
GIVEN a Current Account with no linked virtual accounts WHEN the counts are displayed THEN its count is shown as zero
ears_requirements: The system shall display the total number of virtual accounts the user is entitled to.
The system shall display the number of entitled virtual accounts linked to each Current Account.
The system shall display the number of entitled virtual accounts linked to each Parent VA.
While an entity selection is active, the system shall compute the counts over the selected entities only.
If account data cannot be retrieved, then the system shall show the counts as not available rather than zero.

depends_on.reason: counts are computed over the entitled hierarchy

user_stories.title: View consolidated inflow across entitled virtual accounts
user_stories.description: As a Corporate User, I want to see a consolidated inflow view across my entitled virtual accounts, so that I know how much has been collected without opening each account.
user_stories.dependencies: Relies on the Corporate Banking System for real-time credit data. Uses the same inflow definition as the account details inflow measures.
user_stories.business_validation_rules: The consolidated inflow covers only entitled virtual accounts and is labelled as an inflow measure, not as the physical account balance.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN an entitled Corporate User on the aggregated summary WHEN the summary loads THEN the system shows the consolidated inflow across the entitled virtual accounts
GIVEN the consolidated inflow is displayed WHEN the user reviews it THEN the system shows the amount with its currency and the date basis of the figure

GIVEN entitled virtual accounts are linked to current accounts in different currencies WHEN the inflow is displayed THEN the system shows a separate total per currency without converting between currencies
GIVEN the user has selected specific entities WHEN the inflow is displayed THEN the figure covers only the selected entities
GIVEN credit data cannot be retrieved WHEN the summary loads THEN the system shows the inflow as not available instead of zero
additional_scenarios: GIVEN no credits have been received in the period WHEN the summary loads THEN the system shows a zero inflow with the period basis
GIVEN the inflow figure is displayed WHEN the user hovers or taps the information icon THEN the system explains that the figure is a collection measure and not the current account balance
GIVEN a new credit is attributed to an entitled virtual account WHEN the summary is refreshed THEN the consolidated inflow includes the new credit
ears_requirements: The system shall display the consolidated inflow across the user's entitled virtual accounts in the aggregated summary.
The system shall display the consolidated inflow with its currency and date basis.
Where entitled virtual accounts use different currencies, the system shall display a separate inflow total per currency.
While an entity selection is active, the system shall compute the consolidated inflow over the selected entities only.
If credit data cannot be retrieved, then the system shall show the consolidated inflow as not available rather than zero.

depends_on.reason: the inflow view is part of the aggregated summary

user_stories.title: View all linked virtual accounts in a consolidated list
user_stories.description: As a Corporate User, I want to view all my linked virtual accounts in one consolidated list with their current account, Root VA, Parent VA, type, name, number, nickname, currency and status, so that I can find and compare accounts without switching screens.
user_stories.dependencies: Relies on the Corporate Banking System for virtual account data and entitlements.
user_stories.business_validation_rules: The list shows only entitled virtual accounts. Displayed fields: Current Account Number, Current Account Name, Bank Code/Root VA, Parent Virtual Account Number, Virtual Account Type, Virtual Account Name, Virtual Account Number, Nickname, Currency and Status (Active/Closed).
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN an entitled Corporate User WHEN the user opens the account list THEN the system displays all entitled virtual accounts in a single consolidated list

GIVEN the account list is displayed WHEN the user reviews a row THEN the row shows Current Account Number, Current Account Name, Bank Code/Root VA, Parent VA Number, VA Type, VA Name, VA Number, Nickname, Currency and Status
GIVEN a virtual account of type Customer VA, Add on - Self VA or Add on - On Behalf of VA WHEN the list is displayed THEN the VA Type column shows that type label
GIVEN the user has not defined a nickname for an account WHEN the list is displayed THEN the nickname cell is shown empty and no nickname is required
GIVEN the account data cannot be retrieved WHEN the user opens the list THEN the system displays a service-unavailable message instead of an empty list
additional_scenarios: GIVEN the user has no entitled virtual accounts WHEN the list opens THEN the system displays a no-accounts message
GIVEN the list is displayed on Mobile WHEN space is limited THEN the key fields VA Number, VA Name, Nickname and Status remain visible and the rest are available on expansion
GIVEN the user opens the account list WHEN the list is served THEN the access is recorded in the audit trail
ears_requirements: When an entitled Corporate User opens the account list, the system shall display all entitled virtual accounts in a single consolidated list.
The system shall display Current Account Number, Current Account Name, Bank Code/Root VA, Parent VA Number, VA Type, VA Name, VA Number, Nickname, Currency and Status for each listed virtual account.
The system shall display the virtual account type as Customer VA, Add on - Self VA or Add on - On Behalf of VA.
Where no nickname has been defined for an account, the system shall display an empty nickname cell.
If account data cannot be retrieved, then the system shall display a service-unavailable message rather than an empty list.

depends_on.reason: the list is the next level of the interface hierarchy after the aggregated summary

user_stories.title: Order the account list by favorites, status and opening date
user_stories.description: As a Corporate User, I want the account list to show my favorite accounts first, then Active accounts before other statuses, then accounts by opening date from newest to oldest, so that the accounts I use most are always at the top.
user_stories.dependencies: Uses the favorites from US-039.
user_stories.business_validation_rules: Default order: Rule 1 favorites first; Rule 2 Active accounts then other statuses; Rule 3 opening date newest to oldest.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN a user with favorite and non-favorite accounts WHEN the account list opens THEN all favorite accounts appear before non-favorite accounts
GIVEN accounts within the favorite and non-favorite groups WHEN the list is ordered THEN Active accounts appear before accounts in other statuses within each group
GIVEN accounts with the same favorite flag and status WHEN the list is ordered THEN they are ordered by opening date from newest to oldest
GIVEN the user applies a column sort WHEN the sort is active THEN the chosen sort replaces the default order until it is cleared
GIVEN the user has no favorites WHEN the list opens THEN the order starts with Rule 2 (Active first) and then Rule 3 (opening date)
additional_scenarios: GIVEN the user marks a new favorite WHEN the list is refreshed THEN the account moves into the favorites group at the top
GIVEN two accounts have the same opening date WHEN they are ordered THEN their relative order is stable across page loads
GIVEN the list spans several pages WHEN the user moves between pages THEN the default order is applied across the whole result set, not page by page
ears_requirements: The system shall display favorite accounts before non-favorite accounts in the default account list order.
Within the favorite and non-favorite groups, the system shall display Active accounts before accounts in other statuses.
Within the same favorite flag and status, the system shall order accounts by opening date from newest to oldest.
While a user-selected column sort is active, the system shall apply that sort instead of the default order.
The system shall apply the default order across the whole entitled result set and not per page.

depends_on.reason: ordering applies to the consolidated list
Rule 1 needs the user's favorite accounts

user_stories.title: See Closed virtual accounts for up to 12 months
user_stories.description: As a Corporate User, I want to see virtual accounts in Closed status for up to the last 12 months, so that I can still investigate collections received on recently closed accounts.
user_stories.dependencies: Relies on the Corporate Banking System for account status and closure date.
user_stories.business_validation_rules: Status is Active or Closed. Closed accounts are visible for up to the last 12 months; older Closed accounts are not listed.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN a virtual account closed within the last 12 months WHEN the user opens the account list THEN the account is listed with status Closed
GIVEN a virtual account closed more than 12 months ago WHEN the user opens the account list THEN the account is not listed
GIVEN a Closed account is listed WHEN the user opens its details THEN the details and transaction history within the allowed periods are available
GIVEN the user filters by status Closed WHEN the filter is applied THEN only Closed accounts within the 12-month window are shown
GIVEN a Closed account is listed WHEN the user attempts an account information confirmation for it THEN the account is not selectable because confirmations apply to Active accounts only
additional_scenarios: GIVEN a Closed account reaches 12 months after closure WHEN the list is next loaded THEN the account no longer appears
GIVEN a user searches for the VA number of an account closed more than 12 months ago WHEN the search runs THEN no result is returned and the no-results notification is shown
GIVEN a Closed account is a favorite WHEN the list is ordered THEN it appears in the favorites group after the Active favorites
ears_requirements: The system shall list virtual accounts in Closed status for up to 12 months after closure.
The system shall exclude from the account list virtual accounts closed more than 12 months ago.
The system shall display the status of each listed virtual account as Active or Closed.
When the user filters by status Closed, the system shall show only Closed accounts within the 12-month window.
The system shall prevent Closed accounts from being selected for an account information confirmation.

depends_on.reason: closed accounts appear in the consolidated list

user_stories.title: Download or export the account list in PDF or XLSX
user_stories.description: As a Corporate User, I want to download or export the entire account list or only the accounts I select in PDF or XLSX, so that I can share or reconcile the list outside the portal.
user_stories.dependencies: None beyond the account list in US-007.
user_stories.business_validation_rules: Virtual Account List formats are PDF and XLSX with no digital signature. Exports contain only entitled accounts. Every download is audited.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN an entitled Corporate User on the account list WHEN the user chooses export without selecting rows THEN the system offers to export the entire entitled list
GIVEN the user has selected specific accounts WHEN the user chooses export THEN the system exports only the selected accounts
GIVEN the export dialog is open WHEN the user picks a format THEN the system offers PDF and XLSX only and no digital signature option
GIVEN filters are applied to the list WHEN the user exports the entire list THEN the export contains the filtered entitled result set across all pages
GIVEN the export cannot be generated WHEN the user requests it THEN the system displays an error and no partial file is downloaded
additional_scenarios: GIVEN the user completes an export WHEN the file is downloaded THEN the download is recorded in the audit trail with user identity and timestamp
GIVEN the list contains accounts the user is not entitled to see WHEN the export is generated THEN those accounts are never included
GIVEN the export uses the user's column customization WHEN the file is generated THEN the columns follow the BRD list fields regardless of hidden columns
ears_requirements: When the user exports the account list without a selection, the system shall export the entire entitled list.
When the user exports with selected accounts, the system shall export only the selected accounts.
The system shall offer the Virtual Account List export in PDF and XLSX only, without a digital signature option.
If the export cannot be generated, then the system shall display an error and shall not download a partial file.
When an account list export is downloaded, the system shall record the download with user identity and timestamp in the audit trail.

depends_on.reason: the export takes the consolidated list as input

user_stories.title: Open account details from the account list
user_stories.description: As a Corporate User, I want to open the details of a virtual account I select in the list, so that I can move from the broad list to the account-level information following the module hierarchy.
user_stories.dependencies: Navigation target is the account details view in US-020.
user_stories.business_validation_rules: The interface hierarchy is Aggregated Summary >> Account List >> Account Details >> Transaction History; only entitled accounts can be opened.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN an entitled Corporate User on the account list WHEN the user selects a virtual account row THEN the system opens the account details of that virtual account
GIVEN the user is on the account details WHEN the user goes back THEN the system returns to the account list with the previous filters, sort, page and selection preserved
GIVEN the user follows the hierarchy WHEN the user navigates from the aggregated summary to the list and then to details THEN each level shows data for the same entity selection
GIVEN a virtual account's entitlement was removed after the list loaded WHEN the user selects it THEN the system displays a no-access message instead of the details
GIVEN the details cannot be retrieved WHEN the user selects the row THEN the system displays a service-unavailable message and stays on the list
additional_scenarios: GIVEN a Closed account within the 12-month window WHEN the user selects it THEN the details open showing the Closed status
GIVEN the user opens details on Mobile WHEN the details load THEN the same fields as on Web are available
GIVEN the user opens a virtual account's details WHEN the view is served THEN the access is recorded in the audit trail
ears_requirements: When the user selects a virtual account in the account list, the system shall open that account's details.
When the user returns from account details, the system shall restore the account list filters, sort, page and selection.
The system shall preserve the entity selection across the aggregated summary, account list and account details.
If the selected virtual account is no longer entitled, then the system shall display a no-access message.
If the account details cannot be retrieved, then the system shall display a service-unavailable message and remain on the account list.

depends_on.reason: the list row is the entry point
the details view is the navigation target

user_stories.title: Change rows per page on the account list
user_stories.description: As a Corporate User, I want to change the number of rows shown on the account list between 10, 20 and 50, so that I can scan long lists of virtual accounts at the density I prefer.
user_stories.dependencies: None beyond the account list in US-007.
user_stories.business_validation_rules: Rows per page options are 10 (default), 20 and 50.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN a Corporate User opens the account list WHEN the list loads THEN 10 rows are shown per page by default
GIVEN the account list is displayed WHEN the user opens the pagination control THEN the options 10, 20 and 50 are offered
GIVEN the user selects 20 or 50 rows per page WHEN the selection is applied THEN the list shows that number of rows and recalculates the page count
GIVEN the user changes rows per page WHEN the list refreshes THEN the current filters and sort are kept
GIVEN the result set has fewer rows than the page size WHEN the list is displayed THEN all rows are shown on a single page
additional_scenarios: GIVEN the user is on page 3 with 10 rows per page WHEN the user switches to 50 rows THEN the system shows the page containing the first previously visible row
GIVEN pagination is displayed WHEN the user reviews it THEN the system shows the total number of records
GIVEN the user tries to enter a page size other than 10, 20 or 50 WHEN the control is used THEN only the allowed values can be chosen
ears_requirements: The system shall display 10 rows per page on the account list by default.
The system shall offer 10, 20 and 50 as the rows-per-page options.
When the user selects a rows-per-page option, the system shall display that number of rows and recalculate the page count.
When the rows-per-page value changes, the system shall keep the active filters and sort.
The system shall display the total number of records with the pagination control.

depends_on.reason: pagination applies to the consolidated list

user_stories.title: Search virtual accounts with partial keywords across all pages
user_stories.description: As a Corporate User, I want to search with partial keywords across all information fields and all my virtual accounts on every page, so that I can locate a payer's account quickly in a long list.
user_stories.dependencies: None beyond the account list in US-007.
user_stories.business_validation_rules: Partial search applies across fields such as CIF, Current Account number and name, VA name, Parent VA name and number, Root VA, VA number and nickname, across all entitled VAs on all pages. A notification is shown when nothing matches.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN an entitled Corporate User on the account list WHEN the user enters a partial keyword THEN the system returns every entitled virtual account with a matching value in any searchable field
GIVEN the list spans several pages WHEN the user searches THEN matches from all pages are returned, not only the visible page
GIVEN the keyword matches part of a nickname, VA name or Parent VA name WHEN the search runs THEN the account is included in the results
GIVEN the keyword matches nothing in the entitled accounts WHEN the search runs THEN the system displays a no-records-found notification
GIVEN a keyword matches an account the user is not entitled to WHEN the search runs THEN that account is not returned
additional_scenarios: GIVEN the user clears the search box WHEN the search is cleared THEN the full entitled list is restored with the default order
GIVEN the keyword differs only in letter case or Vietnamese diacritics WHEN the search runs THEN matching follows the platform's standard search normalization
GIVEN search results are displayed WHEN the user exports the list THEN the export contains the search results
ears_requirements: When the user enters a partial keyword, the system shall return every entitled virtual account with a matching value in any searchable field.
The system shall search across all entitled virtual accounts on all pages and not only the visible page.
The system shall include CIF, Current Account number and name, VA name, Parent VA name and number, Root VA, VA number and nickname in the searchable fields.
If no entitled virtual account matches the keyword, then the system shall display a no-records-found notification.
The system shall exclude virtual accounts outside the user's entitlement from search results.

depends_on.reason: search runs over the consolidated list

user_stories.title: Filter by column headers and quick filter by Root VA
user_stories.description: As a Corporate User, I want to filter the account list on any column header and use a quick filter by Root VA, so that I can narrow the list to one collection structure in a single action.
user_stories.dependencies: None beyond the account list in US-007.
user_stories.business_validation_rules: Column filters are available on every column header; the quick filter offers predefined filtering by Root VA. Filter values come only from entitled accounts.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN a Corporate User on the account list WHEN the user opens a column header filter THEN the system offers filter values for that column
GIVEN a column filter value is chosen WHEN the filter is applied THEN only accounts matching that value are listed
GIVEN the account list is displayed WHEN the user opens the quick filter THEN the system lists the user's entitled Root VAs as predefined filters
GIVEN the user selects a Root VA in the quick filter WHEN it is applied THEN only virtual accounts under that Root VA are listed
GIVEN the applied filters match no accounts WHEN the list refreshes THEN the system displays a no-records-found notification
additional_scenarios: GIVEN filters on several columns WHEN they are applied THEN the list shows accounts matching all filters
GIVEN filters are active WHEN the user clears them THEN the full entitled list is restored
GIVEN a Root VA outside the user's entitlement WHEN the quick filter opens THEN that Root VA is not offered
ears_requirements: The system shall provide a filter on every column header of the account list.
When a column filter value is applied, the system shall list only accounts matching that value.
The system shall provide a quick filter listing the user's entitled Root VAs.
When a Root VA quick filter is applied, the system shall list only virtual accounts under that Root VA.
If the applied filters match no accounts, then the system shall display a no-records-found notification.

depends_on.reason: filters apply to the consolidated list

user_stories.title: Use More Filters on CIF, accounts, Root VA, VA and nickname
user_stories.description: As a Corporate User, I want to filter virtual accounts by CIF, Current Account number, Current Account name, Root VA, VA number, VA name and nickname with partial matching, so that I can combine criteria to find exactly the accounts I need.
user_stories.dependencies: Complements the quick filter in US-014.
user_stories.business_validation_rules: More Filters fields: CIF, Current Account number, Current Account name, Root VA, Virtual Account number, Virtual Account name, Account nickname. Partial search applies. If no results are found, a notification is displayed.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN a Corporate User on the account list WHEN the user opens More Filters THEN the fields CIF, Current Account number, Current Account name, Root VA, VA number, VA name and nickname are offered
GIVEN the user enters part of a value in a More Filters field WHEN the filters are applied THEN accounts containing that partial value are listed
GIVEN the user fills several More Filters fields WHEN the filters are applied THEN only accounts matching all entered criteria are listed
GIVEN the More Filters criteria match no accounts WHEN they are applied THEN the system displays a no-results notification
GIVEN More Filters are applied WHEN the user resets them THEN all More Filters fields are cleared and the full entitled list is restored
additional_scenarios: GIVEN More Filters are applied WHEN the user changes rows per page or sorts THEN the filters stay applied
GIVEN the CIF field WHEN the user opens it in a multi-CIF context THEN only entitled CIFs can be chosen
GIVEN More Filters are applied WHEN the user exports the list THEN the export contains the filtered result set
ears_requirements: The system shall offer More Filters on CIF, Current Account number, Current Account name, Root VA, VA number, VA name and nickname.
When a partial value is entered in a More Filters field, the system shall match accounts containing that value.
When several More Filters fields are filled, the system shall list only accounts matching all criteria.
If the More Filters criteria match no accounts, then the system shall display a no-results notification.
When the user resets More Filters, the system shall clear all criteria and restore the full entitled list.

user_stories.title: Sort the account list by any column

GIVEN statement generation WHEN the user selects several virtual accounts THEN the system generates a statement covering each selected account
GIVEN statement generation WHEN the account selector opens THEN only virtual accounts the user is entitled to are offered
GIVEN a from-to period longer than 12 months WHEN the user requests the statement THEN the system rejects the request and states the 12-month maximum

additional_scenarios: GIVEN no account is selected WHEN the user requests a statement THEN the system asks the user to select at least one account

ears_requirements: When the user selects one or more entitled virtual accounts and a from-to period, the system shall generate a statement for the selection.

If the statement period exceeds 12 months, then the system shall reject the request and state the 12-month maximum.
If the from-date is older than the look-up limit or later than the to-date, then the system shall reject the request with a validation message.

depends_on.reason: accounts are selected from the entitled virtual accounts

user_stories.title: Receive statement content with zero opening balance
user_stories.description: As a Corporate User, I want the statement to start from a zero opening balance and include sender, beneficiary and transaction details with the fee breakdown and VAT, so that I can reconcile each receipt against my receivables.
user_stories.dependencies: Shares the balance convention of US-028.
user_stories.business_validation_rules: Opening balance is zero. Content per document table: counterparty / sender account number, name (for credits) and sending bank; beneficiary VA number, name (for credits) and Current Account number; date and timestamp dd/mm/yy hh:mm:ss; transaction reference number; amount and currency; fee breakdown and VAT.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN a generated statement WHEN the user opens it THEN the opening balance is zero
GIVEN a credit transaction on the statement WHEN the user reviews it THEN the sender account number, sender name and sending bank are shown
GIVEN a transaction on the statement WHEN the user reviews it THEN the beneficiary VA number, VA name and Current Account number are shown
GIVEN a transaction on the statement WHEN the user reviews it THEN the date and timestamp in dd/mm/yy hh:mm:ss, the transaction reference number, the amount and currency are shown
GIVEN a transaction with fees WHEN the user reviews it THEN the fee breakdown and VAT are shown
additional_scenarios: GIVEN a statement for several accounts WHEN it is generated THEN each account's section starts from a zero opening balance
GIVEN a period with no transactions WHEN the statement is generated THEN it shows the account details with zero opening and closing balances
GIVEN the statement is generated in different formats WHEN the files are compared THEN they carry the same transactions and balances
ears_requirements: The system shall show a zero opening balance on every virtual account statement.
The system shall show the sender account number, sender name and sending bank for credit transactions on the statement.
The system shall show the beneficiary VA number, VA name and Current Account number for each statement transaction.
The system shall show the date and timestamp in dd/mm/yy hh:mm:ss, the transaction reference number, the amount and the currency for each statement transaction.
The system shall show the fee breakdown and VAT for statement transactions that carry fees.

depends_on.reason: content is produced for the generated statement
uses the same zero-opening running balance convention

user_stories.title: Download the statement in PDF, XLSX or CSV
user_stories.description: As a Corporate User, I want to download the statement in PDF, XLSX or CSV, so that I can file it or load it into my ERP or treasury system.
user_stories.dependencies: None beyond US-031.
user_stories.business_validation_rules: Statement formats are PDF, XLSX and CSV only; every download is audited.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN statement generation WHEN the user opens the format selector THEN PDF, XLSX and CSV are offered and no other format
GIVEN the user selects PDF WHEN the statement is generated THEN a PDF statement is downloaded
GIVEN the user selects XLSX WHEN the statement is generated THEN an XLSX statement is downloaded
GIVEN the user selects CSV WHEN the statement is generated THEN a CSV statement is downloaded
GIVEN the file cannot be produced WHEN the user requests it THEN the system displays an error and no partial file is downloaded
additional_scenarios: GIVEN a statement download completes WHEN it is recorded THEN the audit trail holds user identity, timestamp, accounts and period
GIVEN the CSV format WHEN it is opened THEN each transaction is one row with the statement fields as columns
GIVEN the XLSX format WHEN it is opened THEN amounts are numeric cells
ears_requirements: The system shall offer the virtual account statement in PDF, XLSX and CSV only.
When the user selects a statement format, the system shall produce the statement in that format.
If the statement file cannot be produced, then the system shall display an error and shall not download a partial file.
When a statement is downloaded, the system shall record the download with user identity and timestamp in the audit trail.
The system shall produce identical transaction content in every statement format.

depends_on.reason: formats apply to the generated statement

user_stories.title: Choose a digitally signed PDF statement
user_stories.description: As a Corporate User, I want to choose a digitally signed statement when I download it as PDF, so that I can present an authenticated bank document to auditors or counterparties.
user_stories.dependencies: Relies on the bank's digital signature service. Any fee is defined in the Fees & Charges BRD (BND-001).
user_stories.business_validation_rules: A digital signature is available only for the PDF format; it may incur a fee defined in the Fees & Charges BRD.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN the user selects PDF for a statement WHEN the options are shown THEN the user can choose with or without digital signature
GIVEN the user selects XLSX or CSV WHEN the options are shown THEN no digital signature option is offered
GIVEN the user chooses a digitally signed PDF WHEN the statement is generated THEN the downloaded PDF carries the bank's digital signature
GIVEN a signature may incur a fee WHEN the user chooses the signed option THEN the system informs the user that a fee may apply before generation

GIVEN the digital signature service is unavailable WHEN the user requests a signed PDF THEN the system states that the signature service is temporarily unavailable and does not deliver an unsigned file as signed
additional_scenarios: GIVEN the signature service is unavailable WHEN the user chooses to continue without signature THEN an unsigned PDF is generated
GIVEN a signed PDF WHEN it is opened in a standard PDF reader THEN the signature can be verified
GIVEN a signed statement download WHEN it is audited THEN the audit record shows that a signed document was produced
ears_requirements: Where the PDF format is selected for a statement, the system shall offer the options with and without digital signature.
Where the XLSX or CSV format is selected, the system shall not offer a digital signature option.
When a signed PDF is requested, the system shall produce a PDF carrying the bank's digital signature.
When the user chooses the signed option, the system shall inform the user that a fee may apply.
If the digital signature service is unavailable, then the system shall state that it is temporarily unavailable and shall not label an unsigned file as signed.

depends_on.reason: the signature option applies to the PDF format

user_stories.title: Generate statements above 10,000 records
user_stories.description: As a Corporate User, I want to generate statements whose record volume exceeds the current 10,000-record limitation, so that high-volume collection accounts can still get a complete statement.
user_stories.dependencies: The generation approach for large volumes is a solution-design decision.
user_stories.business_validation_rules: Statements must support large record volumes beyond the current 10,000-records-per-statement limitation; the statement must remain complete.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN a statement request whose period contains more than 10,000 records WHEN the user submits it THEN the system accepts the request instead of rejecting it for volume
GIVEN a large-volume statement WHEN it is delivered THEN it contains every record of the selected accounts and period
GIVEN a large-volume statement takes longer than an interactive response WHEN it is submitted THEN the system informs the user how and when the statement will be available
GIVEN a large-volume statement is ready WHEN the user retrieves it THEN it is downloadable in the format the user selected
GIVEN large-volume generation fails WHEN the failure occurs THEN the user is informed that the statement could not be produced and no incomplete statement is delivered
additional_scenarios: GIVEN a statement of exactly 10,000 records WHEN it is requested THEN it is produced like any other statement
GIVEN a large-volume statement is delivered in several parts WHEN the user receives them THEN the parts are numbered and together hold all records
GIVEN a large-volume statement download completes WHEN it is recorded THEN it is audited like any other statement download
ears_requirements: When a statement request exceeds 10,000 records, the system shall accept and process the request.
The system shall include every record of the selected accounts and period in a large-volume statement.
While a large-volume statement is being produced, the system shall inform the user how and when it will be available.
If large-volume generation fails, then the system shall inform the user and shall not deliver an incomplete statement.
When a large-volume statement is delivered in several parts, the system shall number the parts so that together they hold all records.

depends_on.reason: large-volume handling applies to statement generation

user_stories.title: Generate account confirmation for Active virtual accounts
user_stories.description: As a Corporate User, I want to generate an account information / existence confirmation for one or more Active virtual accounts, so that I can prove the accounts' details to auditors or business partners.
user_stories.dependencies: Relies on the Corporate Banking System for account status and details.
user_stories.business_validation_rules: Confirmation applies to Active accounts only; one or more entitled accounts can be selected.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN an entitled Corporate User on account confirmation WHEN the account selector opens THEN only entitled virtual accounts in Active status are selectable
GIVEN the user selects one Active account WHEN the user requests the confirmation THEN the system generates an account information confirmation for that account
GIVEN the user selects several Active accounts WHEN the user requests the confirmation THEN the system generates a confirmation covering each selected account
GIVEN a Closed account WHEN the user attempts to include it THEN the system prevents the selection and explains that confirmations apply to Active accounts only
GIVEN account data cannot be retrieved WHEN the user requests the confirmation THEN the system displays a service-unavailable message
additional_scenarios: GIVEN an account becomes Closed between selection and submission WHEN the request is submitted THEN the system rejects that account and explains why
GIVEN no account is selected WHEN the user requests a confirmation THEN the system asks for at least one Active account
GIVEN the confirmation is downloaded WHEN the download completes THEN it is recorded in the audit trail
ears_requirements: The system shall offer only entitled virtual accounts in Active status for account confirmation.
When the user requests a confirmation for one or more Active accounts, the system shall generate an account information confirmation covering each selected account.
If the user attempts to include a non-Active account, then the system shall prevent the selection and explain the Active-only rule.
If an account is no longer Active at submission, then the system shall reject that account and explain why.
If account data cannot be retrieved, then the system shall display a service-unavailable message.

depends_on.reason: accounts are selected from the entitled virtual accounts

user_stories.title: Restrict account confirmation to same-day requests
user_stories.description: As a Corporate User, I want account confirmation requests to be limited to the same day, so that the confirmation always reflects the account information on the day it is requested.
user_stories.dependencies: The precise meaning of 'same day' awaits VCB confirmation.
user_stories.business_validation_rules: Account confirmation requests are applicable for the same day only.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN a Corporate User requests an account confirmation WHEN the request form opens THEN the confirmation date is set to the current business day and cannot be changed
GIVEN a confirmation is generated WHEN the user opens it THEN it states the date as of which the account information is confirmed
GIVEN a user attempts to request a confirmation for a past or future date WHEN the request is submitted THEN the system rejects it and explains the same-day rule
GIVEN a confirmation request is submitted WHEN it is processed THEN it uses the account information of the request day
GIVEN the confirmation service is unavailable WHEN the user submits on the day THEN the system displays a service-unavailable message
additional_scenarios: GIVEN the user opened the request form before midnight and submits after midnight WHEN the request is processed THEN the confirmation date is the business day of submission
GIVEN a confirmation was generated earlier today WHEN the user requests another one today THEN a new confirmation is generated
GIVEN the same-day rule is applied WHEN the user views the form THEN a hint explains that confirmations are for the current day only
ears_requirements: The system shall set the account confirmation date to the current business day and shall not allow it to be changed.
The system shall state on the confirmation the date as of which the account information is confirmed.
If a confirmation is requested for a past or future date, then the system shall reject the request and explain the same-day rule.
When a confirmation request is processed, the system shall use the account information of the request day.
If the confirmation service is unavailable, then the system shall display a service-unavailable message.

depends_on.reason: the same-day rule applies to the confirmation request

user_stories.title: Receive account confirmation as PDF with optional signature
user_stories.description: As a Corporate User, I want to receive the account confirmation as a PDF with or without a digital signature, so that I can choose an authenticated document when a third party requires it.
user_stories.dependencies: Relies on the bank's digital signature service. Any fee is defined in the Fees & Charges BRD (BND-001).
user_stories.business_validation_rules: Account information confirmation format is PDF only; a digital signature is optional and only for PDF; it may incur a fee.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN a Corporate User requests an account confirmation WHEN the format options are shown THEN PDF is the only format offered
GIVEN the PDF format WHEN the options are shown THEN the user can choose with or without digital signature
GIVEN the user chooses the signed option WHEN the confirmation is generated THEN the PDF carries the bank's digital signature
GIVEN the user chooses the signed option WHEN the options are confirmed THEN the system informs the user that a fee may apply

GIVEN the digital signature service is unavailable WHEN a signed confirmation is requested THEN the system states that the signature service is temporarily unavailable and does not deliver an unsigned file as signed
additional_scenarios: GIVEN the confirmation is downloaded WHEN the download completes THEN the audit trail records user identity, timestamp and whether it was signed
GIVEN a signed confirmation WHEN it is opened in a standard PDF reader THEN the signature can be verified
GIVEN a confirmation for several accounts WHEN it is generated THEN all accounts appear in the PDF
ears_requirements: The system shall produce the account information confirmation in PDF only.
The system shall offer the account confirmation with and without digital signature.
When a signed confirmation is requested, the system shall produce a PDF carrying the bank's digital signature.
When the signed option is chosen, the system shall inform the user that a fee may apply.
If the digital signature service is unavailable, then the system shall state that it is temporarily unavailable and shall not label an unsigned file as signed.

depends_on.reason: the output applies to the generated confirmation

user_stories.title: Mark and unmark favorite virtual accounts
user_stories.description: As a Corporate User, I want to mark and unmark virtual accounts as favorites so that they are pinned to the top of my account list, so that the accounts I reconcile daily are always first.
user_stories.dependencies: Favorites drive Rule 1 of the default list order.
user_stories.business_validation_rules: Favorites are stored at user-profile level and shown at the top of the account list in order of priority.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN a Corporate User on the account list WHEN the user marks a virtual account as favorite THEN the account is flagged as favorite and pinned to the top of the list
GIVEN a favorite account WHEN the user unmarks it THEN the favorite flag is removed and the account returns to its default position
GIVEN favorites are set WHEN the user signs in again THEN the same accounts are still favorites
GIVEN two users of the same company WHEN one marks a favorite THEN the other user's favorites are unaffected
GIVEN the favorite cannot be saved WHEN the user marks it THEN the system informs the user and leaves the account unflagged
additional_scenarios: GIVEN a favorite account's entitlement is removed WHEN the list loads THEN the account is not shown and does not count toward the favorite limit
GIVEN favorites on Web WHEN the user signs in on Mobile THEN the same favorites are shown
GIVEN a Closed favorite within the 12-month window WHEN the list loads THEN it remains a favorite with its Closed status shown
ears_requirements: When the user marks a virtual account as favorite, the system shall flag it and pin it to the top of the account list.
When the user unmarks a favorite, the system shall remove the flag and return the account to its default position.
The system shall store favorites at user-profile level and keep them across sessions and channels.
The system shall keep each user's favorites independent of other users.
If a favorite cannot be saved, then the system shall inform the user and leave the account unflagged.

depends_on.reason: favorites are marked on the consolidated list

user_stories.title: Limit favorites to 10 accounts
user_stories.description: As a Corporate User, I want to be told when I reach the maximum of 10 favorite accounts, so that I understand why I cannot pin another account and can choose which one to replace.
user_stories.dependencies: Extends US-039.
user_stories.business_validation_rules: At most 10 favorite accounts per user (described as the recommended maximum in BF-AS-VA-07).
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN a user with fewer than 10 favorites WHEN the user marks another account THEN the favorite is saved
GIVEN a user with 10 favorites WHEN the user tries to mark an eleventh account THEN the system prevents it and states the 10-favorite maximum
GIVEN the maximum is reached WHEN the user unmarks a favorite THEN the user can mark another account
GIVEN the maximum message is shown WHEN the user reviews it THEN it suggests removing an existing favorite to add a new one
GIVEN the limit check cannot be performed WHEN the user marks a favorite THEN the system does not save the favorite and informs the user
additional_scenarios: GIVEN favorites set on Web and Mobile WHEN counted THEN the 10-favorite limit applies across both channels
GIVEN 10 favorites WHEN the user views the list THEN all 10 are pinned in the favorites group
GIVEN a favorite becomes unentitled WHEN the limit is checked THEN it does not count toward the 10
ears_requirements: While the user has fewer than 10 favorites, the system shall allow another account to be marked as favorite.
If the user attempts to mark more than 10 favorites, then the system shall prevent it and state the 10-favorite maximum.
When a favorite is unmarked at the maximum, the system shall allow a new favorite to be marked.
The system shall apply the 10-favorite limit per user across Web and Mobile.
The system shall not count unentitled accounts toward the favorite limit.

depends_on.reason: the limit applies to marking favorites

user_stories.title: Create, update or delete a nickname up to 30 characters
user_stories.description: As a Corporate User, I want to create, update or delete a nickname of up to 30 characters for a virtual account, so that I can recognize accounts faster during daily reconciliation.
user_stories.dependencies: Nicknames are displayed in the list, details and history views.
user_stories.business_validation_rules: Nicknames are stored at user-profile level, are at most 30 characters (recommended length in BF-AS-VA-07) and do not change the bank's account name.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN a virtual account without a nickname WHEN the user enters a nickname of up to 30 characters and saves THEN the nickname is stored for that account
GIVEN a virtual account with a nickname WHEN the user edits it and saves THEN the updated nickname replaces the previous one
GIVEN a virtual account with a nickname WHEN the user deletes it THEN the nickname is removed and the field shows empty
GIVEN the user enters more than 30 characters WHEN the user tries to save THEN the system prevents saving and states the 30-character limit
GIVEN the nickname cannot be saved WHEN the user saves THEN the system informs the user and keeps the previous value
additional_scenarios: GIVEN a nickname containing only spaces WHEN the user saves THEN it is treated as deleting the nickname
GIVEN two users of the same company WHEN one sets a nickname THEN the other user does not see it
GIVEN a nickname with Vietnamese diacritics WHEN it is saved THEN it is stored and displayed exactly as entered
ears_requirements: When the user saves a nickname of up to 30 characters, the system shall store it for that virtual account at user-profile level.
When the user edits or deletes a nickname, the system shall update or remove it.
If a nickname longer than 30 characters is entered, then the system shall prevent saving and state the 30-character limit.
The system shall not change the bank's virtual account name when a nickname is saved.
If the nickname cannot be saved, then the system shall inform the user and keep the previous value.

depends_on.reason: nicknames are maintained from the account list or details

user_stories.title: See my nickname across list, details and history
user_stories.description: As a Corporate User, I want the nickname I defined to be shown in the account list, account details and transaction history, so that I can recognize the account wherever it appears.
user_stories.dependencies: Displays nicknames created in US-041.
user_stories.business_validation_rules: The Nickname field appears in the account list, account details and transaction history; it is empty when no nickname is defined and is searchable.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN the user has set a nickname WHEN the user opens the account list THEN the nickname column shows it
GIVEN the user has set a nickname WHEN the user opens the account details THEN the nickname field shows it
GIVEN the user has set a nickname WHEN the user views the transaction history THEN the VA Nick Name field shows it
GIVEN the user has not set a nickname WHEN any of these views is displayed THEN the nickname field is empty
GIVEN the user searches by part of a nickname WHEN the search runs THEN the matching account is returned
additional_scenarios: GIVEN the user updates a nickname WHEN any view is refreshed THEN the new nickname is shown
GIVEN another user's nickname for the same account WHEN this user views the account THEN only this user's own nickname is shown
GIVEN an export of the list or history WHEN it is generated THEN it shows the user's nickname
ears_requirements: The system shall display the user's nickname in the account list, account details and transaction history.
Where no nickname is defined, the system shall display an empty nickname field.
The system shall include nicknames in account search and filters.
When a nickname is updated, the system shall display the new value in all views.
The system shall display only the viewing user's own nickname.

depends_on.reason: the nickname must exist before it is displayed

user_stories.title: Generate a QR code with the virtual account information
user_stories.description: As a Corporate User, I want to generate a QR code with the account information of a selected virtual account, so that my payers can scan it and pay into the right virtual account.

user_stories.business_validation_rules: The QR code contains the account information of the selected entitled virtual account and is produced as an image.

GIVEN the QR image is generated WHEN it is displayed THEN the VA number and VA name are shown beside the image for confirmation
GIVEN a Closed virtual account WHEN the user views it THEN the Generate QR code option is not available
GIVEN a virtual account the user is not entitled to WHEN a QR generation is requested THEN the system denies it
GIVEN QR generation fails WHEN the user requests it THEN the system displays an error and no image is produced
additional_scenarios: GIVEN the generated QR WHEN it is scanned by an app supporting the bank's payment QR scheme THEN the virtual account number is read correctly
GIVEN the user regenerates the QR code WHEN nothing has changed THEN the same account information is encoded
GIVEN the QR code is generated WHEN the action completes THEN it is recorded in the audit trail
ears_requirements: When the user selects Generate QR code for an entitled virtual account, the system shall produce a QR image containing that account's information.
The system shall display the VA number and VA name with the generated QR image.
The system shall not offer QR generation for Closed virtual accounts.
If QR generation is requested for an unentitled account, then the system shall deny it.
If QR generation fails, then the system shall display an error and shall not produce an image.

depends_on.reason: the QR code is generated for a selected virtual account

user_stories.title: Add an amount and payment description to the QR code
user_stories.description: As a Corporate User, I want to enter an amount and a payment description before generating the QR code, so that my payer pays the exact amount with a reference I can reconcile.

acceptance_criteria: GIVEN the QR generation screen WHEN the user opens it THEN optional fields for amount and payment description are shown
GIVEN the user enters a valid amount and description WHEN the QR code is generated THEN the QR encodes the account information, the amount and the description
GIVEN the user leaves both fields empty WHEN the QR code is generated THEN the QR encodes the account information only
GIVEN the user enters a zero, negative or non-numeric amount WHEN the user generates the QR THEN the system rejects the amount with a validation message
GIVEN the description exceeds the length allowed by the payment QR scheme WHEN the user generates the QR THEN the system prevents generation and states the limit
additional_scenarios: GIVEN an amount is entered WHEN it is displayed THEN it shows the virtual account currency

GIVEN a description with Vietnamese diacritics WHEN it is encoded THEN it follows the character rules of the payment QR scheme
ears_requirements: The system shall offer optional amount and payment description fields when generating a QR code.
When an amount and description are entered, the system shall encode them with the account information in the QR code.
When the optional fields are empty, the system shall encode only the account information.
If the amount is zero, negative or non-numeric, then the system shall reject it with a validation message.
If the description exceeds the allowed length, then the system shall prevent generation and state the limit.

depends_on.reason: amount and description extend the QR code

user_stories.title: Download or share the QR code in-app
user_stories.description: As a Corporate User, I want to download the QR code image or share it in-app, so that I can send it to my payers through the channel they use.
user_stories.dependencies: Extends US-043.
user_stories.business_validation_rules: The QR code is available for download or in-app sharing in a visual image format.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN a generated QR code WHEN the user selects Download THEN the QR image is saved to the user's device
GIVEN a generated QR code on Mobile WHEN the user selects Share THEN the device share options open with the QR image attached
GIVEN a generated QR code WHEN it is downloaded or shared THEN the image is in a standard image format
GIVEN a downloaded QR image WHEN it is opened THEN it shows the QR code and the VA number and name
GIVEN the download or share fails WHEN the user retries THEN the system informs the user of the failure
additional_scenarios: GIVEN the user cancels the share sheet WHEN it closes THEN the QR code remains on screen
GIVEN the QR is downloaded WHEN the download completes THEN it is recorded in the audit trail
GIVEN Web without native sharing WHEN the user views the QR THEN Download is offered
ears_requirements: When the user selects Download, the system shall save the QR code as an image to the device.
When the user selects Share on Mobile, the system shall open the device share options with the QR image.
The system shall produce the QR code in a standard image format.
If the download or share fails, then the system shall inform the user.
When a QR code is downloaded, the system shall record the download in the audit trail.

depends_on.reason: the QR image must be generated first

user_stories.title: Receive real-time credit notifications on Mobile, Email and Web
user_stories.description: As a Corporate User, I want to receive a real-time notification on Mobile, Email and Web when a credit is posted to a virtual account I am entitled to, so that I can act on incoming collections immediately.
user_stories.dependencies: Relies on the Corporate Banking System credit events and the platform notification service for push and email delivery.
user_stories.business_validation_rules: A credit notification is pushed in real time with the credit transaction to corporate users via Mobile, Email and Web; only users entitled to the virtual account receive it.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN an entitled Corporate User WHEN a credit transaction is posted to an entitled virtual account THEN the system sends a credit notification in real time
GIVEN a credit notification is sent WHEN the user receives it THEN it is delivered on Mobile, Email and Web
GIVEN a credit notification WHEN the user reads it THEN it shows the virtual account, credit amount, currency and transaction time
GIVEN a user not entitled to the virtual account WHEN a credit is posted THEN that user receives no notification
GIVEN delivery on one channel fails WHEN the notification is sent THEN delivery on the other channels is unaffected and the failure is logged
additional_scenarios: GIVEN the same credit event is received twice WHEN notifications are sent THEN the user receives only one notification for that transaction
GIVEN the user selects a Web notification WHEN it is opened THEN the system shows the virtual account's transaction
GIVEN the notification contains payer details WHEN it is sent THEN it follows the bank's data privacy policy for personal data
ears_requirements: When a credit transaction is posted to a virtual account, the system shall send a real-time credit notification to each entitled corporate user.
The system shall deliver credit notifications on Mobile, Email and Web.
The system shall include the virtual account, credit amount, currency and transaction time in the notification.
The system shall not notify users who are not entitled to the virtual account.
If delivery fails on one channel, then the system shall continue delivery on the other channels and log the failure.

user_stories.title: Enforce hierarchy-level entitlements on every view and download
user_stories.description: As a Corporate User, I want every view, search, count and download to include only the virtual accounts my entitlements allow at Current Account, Root VA, Parent VA or VA level, so that I never see other units' collection data.
user_stories.dependencies: Relies on the entitlements configured in the Corporate Banking System (BND-002). Cross-cutting control used by all inquiry stories.
user_stories.business_validation_rules: Permissions are managed by Current Account, Root VA, Parent VA or VA number. The module is a UI that aggregates Corporate Banking System data and works with the entitlements configured there. Personal data follows Vietnam's Law on Cybersecurity and the bank's privacy policy.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN a user entitled at Current Account level WHEN the user inquires THEN all virtual accounts under that current account are available
GIVEN a user entitled at Root VA or Parent VA level WHEN the user inquires THEN only virtual accounts under that Root VA or Parent VA are available
GIVEN a user entitled to individual VAs WHEN the user inquires THEN only those virtual accounts are available
GIVEN any search, filter, count, aggregate or export WHEN it is computed THEN it includes only the user's entitled virtual accounts
GIVEN a user requests data for an unentitled virtual account by any route WHEN the request is made THEN the system denies access and shows a no-access message
additional_scenarios: GIVEN an entitlement change in the Corporate Banking System WHEN the user next loads a view THEN the new entitlement is applied
GIVEN the entitlement service is unavailable WHEN the user opens the module THEN no account data is shown and a service-unavailable message is displayed
GIVEN an access denial WHEN it occurs THEN it is recorded in the audit trail
ears_requirements: The system shall apply the entitlements configured in the Corporate Banking System at Current Account, Root VA, Parent VA or VA level to every virtual account view.
The system shall include only entitled virtual accounts in every search, filter, count, aggregate and export.
If a user requests data for an unentitled virtual account, then the system shall deny access and display a no-access message.
When an entitlement changes, the system shall apply the new entitlement on the next request.
If the entitlement service is unavailable, then the system shall show no account data and display a service-unavailable message.

user_stories.title: Record an audit trail of access and downloads
user_stories.description: As a Bank Compliance Officer, I want every access to virtual account information and every download recorded with user identity and timestamp, so that the bank can evidence who viewed or extracted data for the regulatory retention period.
user_stories.dependencies: Relies on the platform audit store; the retention period is the regulatory minimum.
user_stories.business_validation_rules: The audit trail tracks all access and downloads with user identity and timestamp and is retained for the regulatory minimum period.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN a Corporate User opens any virtual account view WHEN the view is served THEN an audit record is written with user identity, timestamp, view and accounts accessed

GIVEN a Corporate User downloads any list, history, statement, confirmation or QR image WHEN the download completes THEN an audit record is written with user identity, timestamp, document type and accounts
GIVEN audit records exist WHEN the retention period has not elapsed THEN the records are retained and cannot be altered
GIVEN the audit store is unavailable WHEN a user requests a download THEN the download is not delivered until it can be audited
GIVEN a Bank Compliance Officer reviews the audit trail WHEN records are queried by user or date THEN the matching records are returned
additional_scenarios: GIVEN an access denial for an unentitled account WHEN it occurs THEN it is also recorded in the audit trail
GIVEN an audit record contains personal data WHEN it is stored THEN it is protected in line with the bank's data privacy policy
GIVEN the same user accesses on Web and Mobile WHEN records are written THEN each record states the channel
ears_requirements: When a user accesses virtual account information, the system shall record the user identity, timestamp, view and accounts accessed.
When a user downloads a virtual account document, the system shall record the user identity, timestamp, document type and accounts.
The system shall retain audit records unaltered for the regulatory minimum period.
If the audit store is unavailable, then the system shall not deliver a download until it can be audited.
The system shall record the channel of each audited access.

assumptions_register.assumption_text: The CIF shown in the single-CIF scenario is the corporate entity (CIF) of the user; the BRD glossary defines 'Entity' as an individual staff member, which conflicts with its use for CIF selection in BF-AS-VA-01. Stories use Entity = corporate legal entity / CIF.
VA counts per Parent VA, per Current Account and in total are computed over the entitled population only, not the corporate's full hierarchy.

The 'consolidated inflow of cash position view' period is not defined in the BRD; it is assumed to aggregate today's inflow across the entitled virtual accounts. It is a collection measure, not the physical account balance.
Nickname is marked Mandatory for display in Section 5.2.1 although nickname creation is optional; when no nickname has been defined the field is shown empty. Users are not forced to create nicknames.

[GAP] Currency is described as the settlement-account currency in Section 5.2.1 and as the virtual account currency in Sections 5.2.2 and 5.2.3; assumed the VA inherits the currency of its linked current account pending VCB confirmation.
The 12-month visibility window for Closed virtual accounts is measured from the account closure date.
Sorting applies to the whole entitled result set across pages, not only the visible page, consistent with the BRD's all-pages search requirement.
assumptions_register.feature_context: FEAT-003 Account list search, filter and display controls

assumptions_register.assumption_text: Today's inflow and month-to-date credits use the bank's business date and Vietnam time; they are collection measures and do not represent funds held by the virtual account, which holds no independent balance (Glossary).
Entitlement to a virtual account does not imply entitlement to its linked Current Account; the redirect requires the separate current account entitlement.
[GAP] The historical look-up limit is stated as 3-5 years; it is treated as a configurable parameter until VCB fixes the figure.

[GAP] The closing balance is assumed to be the net of period credits and debits from the zero opening balance; it is a reporting figure and must not be presented as the physical deposit balance. Treatment of reversals and parent roll-ups is not specified.
History at Root VA / Parent level aggregates only entitled descendant VAs and lists each transaction once, with no double counting across hierarchy levels.

The Section 8 glossary definitions of Account Information Confirmation, Transaction Reference Number and Statement appear shifted by one row; stories follow the Section 3.2.1 (a) document table for the meaning of each document.
The mechanism for statements above 10,000 records (asynchronous generation, file splitting or other) is a solution-design decision; stories specify only the business outcome.
[GAP] 'Same day request only' is interpreted as the confirmation certifying account information as of the request date, with the request placed on that business day; VCB to confirm.
The favorite limit (10) and nickname length (30) are described as 'recommended' in BF-AS-VA-07 but as limits in Section 3.2.1; stories enforce them as hard limits pending BA confirmation.
[GAP] The QR payload standard is not specified in the BRD; the QR code is assumed to follow the bank's approved payment QR scheme.
In-app sharing uses the device's native share options on Mobile; on Web the QR code is offered as a download.

[GAP] The triggering event is assumed to be the credit being attributed to the virtual account; recipients are entitled corporate users; handling of reversals and duplicate events is not specified in the BRD.
Virtual account types (Customer VA, Add on - Self VA, Add on - On Behalf of VA) are displayed only; the BRD defines no type-specific behaviour or permissions.
